question: In Vaishnavism, how many avatars or incarnation of deity were recognised?
solution:
The correct answer is **__10__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **Vaishnavism**, **10 avatars **or **incarnations **of deity were recognized.

 
 
• **Matsya (Fish)**
 
• **Tortoise**
 
• **Boar**
 
• **Man-lion**
